That"},{"id":"p1s3","text":" cuts down the network and parsing problems an agent may hit when accessing GitH"},{"id":"p2s1","text":"# dsh-github-router"},{"id":"p3s1","text":"**English** | 中文"},{"id":"p4s1","text":"> Read-only GitHub access for a DeepSeek Harness project — load PRs, issues, files, and API data thr"},{"id":"p4s2","text":"ough tools that route internally (API, gh CLI, git protocol, page HTML, mirrors), so an agent never "},{"id":"p4s3","text":"burns turns fighting shell-side TLS or proxy failures."},{"id":"p5s1","text":"A DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle that gives agents GitHub reads without shell retries:"},{"id":"p6s1","text":"- **Five read-only tools** — `github_probe`, `github_pr`, `github_issue`, `github_file`, `github_api"},{"id":"p6s2","text":"` — plus the `github-router` skill and a system-prompt guidance section. No write, push, comment, or"},{"id":"p6s3","text":" mutation capability exists anywhere in the package.
- **In-tool routing** — every request runs host"},{"id":"p6s4","text":"-side (outside the sandbox's TLS/proxy restrictions) and falls through a route ladder: `api.github.c"},{"id":"p6s5","text":"om` (direct → proxy) → `gh` CLI (read-only subcommands) → git protocol (plugin fetch cache, or a loc"},{"id":"p6s6","text":"al clone read with log/diff/show only) → PR/issue page HTML (strict JSON island extraction) → user-c"},{"id":"p6s7","text":"onfigured raw mirrors.

- **Connectivity probe** — "},{"id":"p6s10","text":"`github_probe` reports which routes are live from the host in one call, with timings and a recommend"},{"id":"p6s11","text":"ed route chain.
- **Zero runtime dependencies** — peers resolve from the DSH profile; proxied reques"},{"id":"p6s12","text":"ts travel through the plugin's own CONNECT tunnel (no third-party HTTP stack), so the package instal"},{"id":"p6s13","text":"ls fully offline.

Each part records the route that served it.
[该节后续省略]"},{"id":"p29s1","text":"## How it works"},{"id":"p30s1","text":"- **Host-side execution** — plugin code runs in the host process, so the sandbox's TLS credential re"},{"id":"p30s2","text":"sets and proxy misrouting never apply. The unrestricted token is compensated by the confinement mode"},{"id":"p30s3","text":"l in SECURITY.md — not by weakening the sandbox.
- **Explicit proxy decisions** — global `fetch` doe"},{"id":"p30s4","text":"s not inherit ambient proxy env; each attempt gets an explicit direct/proxy choice, and proxied requ"},{"id":"p30s5","text":"ests use a zero-dependency CONNECT tunnel (`node:http`/`node:tls`) with target-hostname TLS validati"},{"id":"p30s6","text":"on and `accept-encoding: identity`.
- **Strict parsing** — the page-HTML route extracts only `react-"},{"id":"p30s7","text":"app.embeddedData` JSON islands and runs `JSON.parse` (never evaluated); a bounded BFS copies a white"},{"id":"p30s8","text":"list of fields, so CSRF tokens and the raw payload never reach the model.
- **Argv-only subprocesses"},{"id":"p30s9","text":"** — every `gh`/`git` invocation is an argv array with fixed flag lists; user input reaches argv onl"},{"id":"p30s10","text":"y after regex validation, and nothing is shell-interpolated.
- **Tool contract** — canonical values "},{"id":"p30s11","text":"are lossless JSON (arrays carry no side properties), byte-capped, and rendered as compact text with "},{"id":"p30s12","text":"route attribution.
- **Skill & guidance** — the `github-router` skill teaches tool-first usage and t"},{"id":"p30s13","text":"he "never escalate for GitHub reads" rule; one system-prompt section (`dsh-github-router:guidance`, "},{"id":"p30s14","text":"order 118) reminds every session that the github_* tools are the sanctioned path."},{"id":"p31s1","text":"## Security"},{"id":"p32s1","text":"Read-only by construction: no write verb exists, tokens attach only to
`api.github.com` and are reda"},{"id":"p32s2","text":"cted on every boundary, page payloads are
whitelist-extracted, and the only disk writes are the two "},{"id":"p32s3","text":"plugin-owned
caches under `<DSH_HOME>/storages/dsh-github-router/`. See
SECURITY.md for the complete"},{"id":"p32s4","text":" threat model and mitigation
list."}],"truncated":true}
